audit_items.proof_trace: GetBlobsV2 data bypasses KZG verification entirely. Line 706 comment explicitly states 'We trust the execution layer' and directly upgrades RODataColumn to VerifiedRODataColumn without cryptographic validation, unlike GetBlobsV1 (line 641) which calls blobVerifier. Compromised EL can inject invalid blobs that violate KZG commitment integrity.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker controls compromised EL, returns malformed blobs via engine_getBlobsV2 with invalid KZG proofs or mismatched cell data. CL constructs DataColumnSidecars without verification (line 714), marks them verified, broadcasts to P2P network, causing consensus clients to accept invalid data columns and potentially trigger slashing or chain corruption.
